scope: Application-facing native Engine feature aliases, canonical whole-frame update/rejection path, Blitz tree/style/layout/event/render integration, consumed-ID lifecycle retirement, active caller migration and VM regressions.

canonical_entry.legacy_execution: LegacyEngine only; active examples and diagnostic caller do not import Taffy, PaintOp or UiBatch execution
canonical_entry.diagnostic_dependency: experiments/blitz-host depends only on jasper-ui-engine through native-engine/native-engine-cpu

whole_frame_behavior.success: The ordered patch frame is applied atomically to the retained source snapshot, a detached terminal Blitz candidate is built, and only then replaces the active view with the exact successor version.
whole_frame_behavior.content: Insert, remove, same-batch remove/reinsert ordering, style, semantics and text changes use the one terminal candidate path.
whole_frame_behavior.rejection: Owner, lifecycle, empty/capacity, stale/successor, source and native-construction rejection leave tree, version, focus, viewport, scroll, frame cache and needs_frame unchanged.
whole_frame_behavior.consumed_identity: Removing a node or ancestor retires its native press and focus identity. Reusing the same NodeId inside that frame cannot transfer a press/focus or activate the replacement on a late Up.
whole_frame_behavior.rendering: Pinned Blitz owns native tree/style/layout/events; Parley/Vello CPU paints the frame; RenderBackend receives exact RGBA8 bytes and presents only after successful adoption.

validation.vm: 3G RAM, zero swap, 128 tasks, cargo jobs=1, host CPU isolation through scripts/verify-in-vm.sh

native_all_targets.notes: All integration suites and example targets compiled and passed; GPU-only tests are cfg-gated off in this CPU run.

proof_correspondence.result: current for affected scene kernels: scene-update-admission, scene-frame-completion, scene-host-close, scene-snapshot-identity, scene-host-identity and semantic-role-tag
proof_correspondence.limitation: The whole-adapter evidence mapping cannot be declared current in this worktree because unrelated generated evidence directories are absent, not because the affected mappings failed.

remaining_verification_for_claude: Formalize Scene::apply_batch_at over an arbitrary ordered frame, including node insertion/removal, remove/reinsert identity reuse and exact one-step version advancement.
Formalize the detached NativeScene candidate construction/refinement to the authoritative terminal Scene, including all Blitz tree/style/layout fields.
Formalize the final active-view swap and host-visible state restoration: focus, viewport scroll, hover, pressed node, frame cache and dirty state.
Prove the negative branch preserves exactly the prior view/frame/version, including third-party failure assumptions; third-party panic rollback remains outside the current contract.
Replace the 32-case Proptest evidence with a complete implementation-level ordered acceptance if the project requires item 2 to be formally checked.
explicit_tcb: fontique and Parley font selection, shaping and layout
Rust allocation, BTreeMap/BTreeSet and FP behavior unless covered by a later formal model
host Surface/device acquisition, composition and presentation
limitations: The feature names are stable application call points; they do not imply that the full formal acceptance is complete.
This run validates CPU Blitz/Vello rendering. Hardware GPU, compositor/vsync, device-loss and real system accessibility/IME services remain outside item 2 engineering evidence.
Third-party panic rollback is not claimed.
